research_mode: official Police.uk and Home Office sources only; monthly API currency, availability, stop-search spatial limits and current outcomes-framework controls; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: API crime-data update frequency
verified_claims: crime data in the API are updated once a month
the endpoint reports the latest crime-data month
currency must be checked before a dated extraction
limitations: monthly refresh does not guarantee every force-product combination is complete
the endpoint is not a parcel-data timestamp

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Last-updated date-field semantics
verified_claims: the response uses an ISO-formatted date
the date represents the month of latest crime data
the documented day component is irrelevant and exists for standard formatting
limitations: the day must not be interpreted as an exact extraction or incident date
month semantics must be retained

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Street-data availability calendar
verified_claims: the availability method returns a list of available datasets
each entry identifies a year-month for available street-level crime data
availability is explicitly versioned by month
limitations: a listed month does not prove every optional field is populated
availability is not evidence of parcel accuracy

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Stop-search force coverage by month
verified_claims: each availability entry can contain a stop-and-search list
the list contains force IDs that supplied stop-search data for that month
force coverage can therefore vary by month
limitations: absence from the list is unavailable data rather than zero searches
force IDs require exact identifier matching

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Force stop-search default-month caveat
verified_claims: the date parameter is optional
the latest month is used by default
the latest month can contain no data for the requested force and the availability method should be used when date significance matters
limitations: an empty default response must not be interpreted as no stop-search activity
reproducible use requires a pinned month

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Stop-search anonymised-location boundary
verified_claims: returned stop-search locations are approximations
the locations are not the exact places where searches occurred
the same location-anonymisation principle applies as for crimes
limitations: coordinates must not be joined as exact incident points
approximate context cannot establish parcel-level exposure

sources.name: Current crime-outcomes release edition
verified_claims: the current crime-outcomes release was published on 23 July 2026
it applies to England and Wales
it covers police-assigned outcomes for the financial year ending March 2026
limitations: publication date is not the date of every offence or outcome
the release remains aggregate official statistics

sources.name: Broader outcomes-framework supply history
verified_claims: before April 2013 official reporting focused on detections
the framework was revised from April 2013
police forces have supplied the broader outcome set since April 2014
limitations: pre-framework and current outcome series require mapping
framework history is not a performance ranking

sources.name: Outcome-framework non-ranking purpose
verified_claims: the framework was intended to recognise the full range of disposals
it was designed not to favour one outcome over another
the emphasis is on the appropriateness of the disposal and professional judgement
limitations: outcome codes must not be converted into an ordinal success scale
appropriateness cannot be inferred from aggregate counts alone

sources.name: Monthly large-change validation
verified_claims: Home Office analysts perform routine monthly validation checks
checks look for large or unusual changes from the previous month
the checks cover offences outcomes and transferred or cancelled records
limitations: a passed aggregate check is not a record-level audit
unusual change can be genuine and requires force explanation
